subject: inox_l9_bootstrap_repair_and_full_runtime_behavior_validation
authority_source: Principal request to continue L9 debugging and finish putting it in working order; explicit FixBugsFirst doctrine and agent coding attribution requirement
mission: Restore boot of the opt-in L9 object environment and generated stdlib, then verify actual method dispatch and track remaining runtime correctness defects before claiming L9 is fully operational.

checkpoint.result: L9 bootstrap remains successful. Root repairs to loop-while, loop-until and three range helpers pass 82 executable loop/stack-continuation tests across minimal and L9 modes. Iteration consumes constant control depth up to 1000 cycles; no recursive fallback was introduced. Full L9 actors/tasks/promises remain incomplete.
completed_repair_steps: class{ saves the outer code value before entering extend-class{ to avoid dynamic-scope self-recursion
make.task stub explicitly supplies task/ receiver to make{
multiline stdlib verb terminators are attached to the end of the preceding instruction, eliminating phantom missing-verb .
stdlib class extensions are compiled inside initialize-stdlib-classes with matching brace indentation
integer.times is registered with a stack-only tail-recursive helper; direct nested from:to:do: is not presently reliable
agent-authored .nox comments are ASCII-only because non-ASCII source comments cause text-cell assertions
loop-while checker now continues only while condition is true, not false
both while-checker and until-checker preserve their permanent CSP frames across all iterations
both loop checkers retrieve after-loop continuation from the sentinel before clearing it, without dropping unrelated caller frames
loop-until no longer invokes debugger unconditionally
three from:...:do: range helpers now use valid postfix comparisons, repaired iterative loops, inclusive bounds and signed steps
82 regression cases validate loop behavior, resumption and 1000-iteration constant CSP depth in both minimal and L9 modes
Global root-cause-first/no-silent-workaround rule recorded in Cogentia engineering policy and specialized in Inox AGENTS.md
known_remaining_defects: make.task still contains a visible stub and is not the full task maker
unbounded CSP growth during recursion can overwrite parser memory in the historical JS VM; separate general control-stack correctness fix needed
L9 actor, promise, scheduler and full inheritance semantics lack a dedicated end-to-end suite
stdlib.nox is marked derived but no checked-in generator was found; regeneration needs a reproducible source
integer.times retains the former recursive workaround because direct nested it-method{ ... from: ... } compilation fails; this is a separate known compiler bug, not a repaired feature
zero-step range invalid input invokes the historical FATAL hook but its error diagnostics and nested-scope unwinding remain defective
proper tail-call elimination/again is specified but not implemented; no recursion replaces the fixed loops

next_packet_candidate: Fix the root cause of nested it-method{...from:...} compilation; fix FATAL scoped error propagation and CSP bounds checks in the core VM; then exercise full L9 task/promise/actor runtime under issue #16.
